bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident and aggressive; management emphasizes sustained sales momentum, robust launch pipeline, and disciplined capital allocation. Tone is bullish on demand resilience, with strong focus on execution and inventory replenishment to support INR 12,000Cr+ annual run rate.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Despite INR 4,700Cr collections and INR 3,900Cr development spend, company maintains positive cash flow due to non-consolidated JV debt (INR 1,200Cr) and commercial assets not yet contributing to P&L; AIF capital is being deployed in affordable segment, not luxury, to avoid margin compression; Mumbai’s Mulund project sold 60% of launched inventory (INR 1,100Cr) in just 4 months, indicating strong micro-market traction.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Diversified development platform across asset classes and geographies, generating multi-channel income streams and reducing dependence on any single asset class
- Proven execution capability built over nearly four decades, supported by experienced leadership and a consistent delivery track record
- Trusted brand - credibility in legacy markets and new geographies enabling rapid customer acceptance
- Customer-centric approach: design around changing customer aspirations, quality construction and superior post-possession support
- Financial discipline - prudent capital allocation balancing expansion with healthy cash flow generation
- Future-ready pipeline - land bank and diversified development pipeline across geographies and asset classes
- Deep, long-standing landowner relationships that often yield repeat opportunities and access to high-quality land at disciplined valuations
- Integrated lifecycle platform from land identification through development, delivery and property management, retaining quality and execution control

business.body: Prestige Estates Projects Limited is one of India's leading real estate developers, founded in Bengaluru in 1986, with a diversified presence across residential, commercial, retail, hospitality and property management & services. It runs an integrated development platform spanning the entire real estate lifecycle - identifying and acquiring land parcels through long-standing landowner relationships, planning and designing with international architects, executing through leading contractors, marketing and delivering via channel partners and Customer Experience Centres, and then managing completed assets. Its portfolio comprises residential communities, Grade A office developments, destination retail centres, premium hospitality assets and integrated mixed-use developments across India's major property markets.

outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

outlook.body:
- Build a truly national developer: after the maiden residential launch in NCR (The Prestige City Indirapuram) and completion of maiden developments in Mumbai, deepen presence in India's fastest-growing urban centres
- Rapidly expand the annuity business so that recurring rental income complements the development business and improves predictability and resilience of cash flows
- Commercial office: bring several marquee developments in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Chennai and Kochi progressively into operation to build a portfolio of institutional-quality Grade A office assets
- Retail: develop several new malls across multiple cities so the retail segment becomes an increasingly meaningful contributor to the annuity portfolio
- Hospitality: execute the Delhi Aerocity luxury development and a pipeline across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Sakleshpur and Goa to expand room inventory and recurring income
- Residential remains the primary growth engine - create thoughtfully designed communities combining quality, lifestyle and long-term value
- Scale property management and other services as a recurring, scalable revenue stream that deepens customer experience across the asset lifecycle and strengthens execution and quality control
- Strengthen the development pipeline through disciplined business development, adding strategically located projects across Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad and Chennai
- Maintain disciplined capital allocation while pursuing scale - 'building an institution with multiple complementary engines of growth'
- Embed safety and sustainability in planning, design and operations - green building practices, resource efficiency, site safety, and rehabilitation / social housing / urban renewal initiatives
- BRSR Core indicators for the year ended 31 March 2026 were subject to independent reasonable assurance by Vinay and Keshava LLP, Chartered Accountants, whose opinion (dated 22 July 2026) concluded the indicators are prepared in all material respects in accordance with the SEBI 'BRSR Core' criteria
- GHG footprint assured under Principle 6 - E7: total Scope 1 emissions, total Scope 2 emissions and GHG emission intensity (Scope 1+2) per rupee of turnover adjusted for PPP and per unit of output
- Water footprint assured under Principle 6 - E3/E4: total water consumption, water consumption intensity (per rupee of turnover adjusted for PPP and per physical output) and water discharge by destination and level of treatment
- Energy footprint assured under Principle 6 - E1: total energy consumed, percentage of energy consumed from renewable sources, and energy intensity per rupee of turnover adjusted for PPP and per physical output
- Circularity and waste management assured under Principle 6 - E9, covering plastic, e-waste, bio-medical, construction and demolition, battery, radioactive and other hazardous / non-hazardous waste, waste intensity, and waste recovered through recycling / re-use versus disposed by method
- Employee wellbeing and safety assured under Principle 3 - E1(c) and E11: spending on employee and worker wellbeing as a percentage of total revenue, Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (per one million person-hours worked) and number of fatalities, including the contract workforce
- Gender diversity assured under Principle 5 - E3(b) and E7: gross wages paid to females as a percentage of total wages, and POSH complaints reported, as a percentage of female employees / workers, and upheld
- Sustainability reporting aligned to the SEBI BRSR framework and to the Integrated Reporting Framework <IR> (IFRS Foundation) and SEBI Guidance on Integrated Reporting, with the report structured around six capitals including Natural capital
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: Expansion is geographic and asset-class led rather than plant-based. Founded in Bengaluru in 1986, Prestige has expanded across southern and western India and into the National Capital Region, and is now present in 13 cities including Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune and Kochi; the recent foray into NCR and Mumbai is described as evidence of its intent to keep expanding. FY 26 project launches and completions spanned NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Kochi, with the wider footprint also covering Ooty, Kozhikode, Mysore, Mangaluru, Goa, Pune and Sakleshpur. The largest build-out underway is in the annuity portfolio: across the Commercial Office portfolio several marquee developments are taking shape in Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Chennai and Kochi, and, supported by strong leasing momentum and healthy occupier demand, these assets will progressively become operational over the next few years, significantly expanding recurring rental income and building a portfolio of institutional-quality Grade A office assets. In retail, several new malls are under development across multiple cities, which management expects will make Retail an increasingly meaningful contributor to the annuity portfolio. In hospitality, the landmark luxury development at Delhi Aerocity, featuring globally renowned hotel brands, is progressing well and is expected to become operational during FY 27, beyond which there is a pipeline of hospitality developments across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Sakleshpur and Goa that will progressively come on stream and significantly expand room inventory. The land-side engine is a disciplined acquisition model that leverages deep market knowledge and long-standing landowner relationships to secure strategically located parcels, and the development pipeline is described as one of the largest and most diversified in the company's history, continually strengthened through disciplined business development.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Residential demand driven by genuine end-user aspirations, rising incomes and growing confidence in organised developers
- Commercial real estate remains buoyant as India strengthens its position as the preferred destination for Global Capability Centres and multinational corporations
- Organised retail benefiting from rising consumption and changing consumer preferences
- Hospitality seeing sustained momentum from increasing business travel, tourism and India's expanding global relevance
- Indian economy resilient - supported by prudent policymaking, sustained infrastructure investment, healthy domestic consumption and favourable demographics; accelerating urbanisation raises the importance of urban infrastructure and built environment
- Office portfolio recorded healthy leasing momentum with occupancy above 92%, reflecting sustained demand from Global Capability Centres, technology companies and leading domestic corporates
- Retail portfolio occupancy of approximately 99%, with retailers in the malls recording gross turnover exceeding Rs 25,671 mn during the year
- Hospitality business supported by strong ARRs and occupancies, improving travel demand and continued focus on operational efficiencies
- Annuity assets under construction will progressively become operational over the next few years, significantly expanding recurring rental income and creating a more resilient earnings profile
- Sold but unrecognised revenue provides exceptional visibility into future revenue recognition and earnings
- Sold but unrecognised revenue of Rs 659,353 mn, described as providing 'exceptional visibility into future revenue recognition and earnings, underpinning our financial performance in the years ahead'
- Business development pipeline strengthened with projects carrying an estimated GDV of over Rs 514,200 mn across Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad and Chennai
- FY26 new launches of 31.84 mn sft with an estimated GDV of Rs 273,504 mn, which generated sales of Rs 173,422 mn
- Management describes executing 'one of the largest and most diversified development pipelines in our history across India's leading cities'
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

The company is strategically building an annuity commercial portfolio while maintaining low leverage and deploying AIF capital to fund growth without dilution.

meta.thesis: Prestige Estates is executing a high-velocity sales and launch strategy across key metros, with strong cash collections and a robust pipeline of 15M+ sq.ft. upcoming projects, positioning it to sustain INR 12,000Cr+ annual sales despite rate hikes. The company is strategically building an annuity commercial portfolio while maintaining low leverage and deploying AIF capital to fund growth without dilution.
